Article 9 (Awards, etc.)
(1) The Audit and Inspection Research Institute may grant monetary awards or commendations to employees with excellent research achievements or research cooperation activities and to persons who have contributed to the development of audit and inspection research, etc. The maximum amount of such a monetary award shall be two million won. <Amended on July 15, 2019.>
(2) The President of the Institute may, with the approval of the Chairperson of the Board of Audit and Inspection, determine detailed matters necessary for compensation and awards, etc.
